Compatibility intelligence

“Good player” is not a position.

A good footballer is not automatically the right footballer. Formation, role, age group, team need and development stage all matter in football terms.

ScoutLink shortlists. Scouts decide. The technology points attention; the football judgement stays human — the scout still watches the player, speaks to the right people and makes the call.

Controlled visibility

No open directory of children. Obviously.

Scout access is reviewed and permissioned. Player context is coach-led. Interest is routed through appropriate adults, clubs and teams — never straight to a child. More visibility should not mean uncontrolled exposure.

Reviewed scout access

Every scout account is checked before it sees a single player.

Coach-led records

The coach builds the evidence. The child never self-promotes.

Adult-led contact

Interest goes coach → club → appropriate adult. Always.

About Stratex

We didn’t start in a boardroom. We started on touchlines.

Stratex exists because opportunity in grassroots football is far too random — and the information that should fix that doesn’t travel.

Meet the leadershipSee what we’re building

Stratex Analytics builds professional technology for non professional grassroots players, coaches and organisations. We create products that give grassroots football access to tools, structure and visibility that are usually only available in academy or professional environments.

Our work is focused on improving player development and creating clearer pathways for talent to be seen by scouts, agents and decision makers. We build tools that help coaches properly understand, track and support their players, while giving serious grassroots players stronger ways to showcase who they are, how they play and what they could become.

Stratex was created by a team that understands the reality of non professional grassroots football: limited resources, limited exposure, and too many players relying on chance. We exist to help grassroots football leverage better technology, better data and better visibility, so talent is not held back by the level it starts at.

“You should come and watch this kid” is useful. It just isn’t infrastructure.

Data-heavy, football-first. The numbers serve the football — never the other way round.

Trust & safeguarding

Safeguarding is built in, not bolted on.

ScoutLink involves young players, so the controls are built into how the platform works — not added to the website afterwards.

How Scout verification worksReport a concern
01Reviewed Scout access

Scout accounts are checked and approved before they can view player information. No self-serve access to children’s data.

02Controlled player visibility

Player context is coach-led and permissioned. There is no public, browsable directory of young players.

03Adult-led communication

Interest is routed through coaches, clubs and appropriate adults — never directly to a child.

04Private concern handling

Concerns are logged, reviewed by a named senior person and handled confidentially.

05Data privacy

Player information is collected for football purposes, minimised, and never sold. Details in the privacy policy.

06Account & access controls

Role-based permissions, so people only see what their role in football justifies.

07Where parents fit in

Parents and guardians stay informed and involved — consent where required, visibility over what exists about their child.

08How to report something

Anyone can raise a safeguarding, conduct, privacy or access concern — without knowing the correct category first.

Some friction is intentional. Particularly when the alternative is giving everybody access to everything.

Something you want to check first?

Read the detail, or ask a human before your club commits to anything.

Security

Security, explained plainly.

What we actually do to protect accounts and information — described plainly, promised carefully.

Authentication & access

Accounts protected by strong authentication; access is role-based and reviewed.

Restricted information

Player information is limited to the people whose football role justifies seeing it.

Private file access

Uploads (video, evidence) are private by default and shared only through permissions.

Secure transport

Data moves over encrypted connections between you and Stratex.

Auditability

Access to sensitive information is logged, so unusual behaviour can be spotted and investigated.

Backup & recovery

Regular backups and a tested path to restore service if something breaks.

Found a vulnerability?

Accessibility

A good experience should work for everyone.

These are the standards we build to across the site and ScoutLink — and what to do if we’ve missed something.

Keyboard navigation

Everything reachable and operable without a mouse, with visible focus.

Screen-reader support

Meaningful names, roles and states on interactive elements.

Semantic structure

Proper headings and landmarks so pages make sense out loud.

Contrast

Text meets WCAG contrast levels — including on the green.

Zoom & text resizing

Layouts hold together at 200% zoom and larger text settings.

Form labels

Every field labelled; errors explained in words, not colour alone.

Alternative text

Images that carry meaning get real descriptions.

Ongoing improvement

Accessibility reviewed as part of building, not audited once a year.

Hit a barrier?

Tell us what happened and where — we’ll fix it or find you another route.
